definitions.explanation: One's sense of self or individual identity. Used in both everyday and philosophical or psychological contexts. Composed of 自 (self) + 我 (I, ego). Often appears in discussions of child development, psychology, and personal growth.

examples.japanese: {自我|じが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}める→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三歳|さんさい}ごろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{自我|じが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽生|めば}える→芽生える：04594_mebaeru⟧。
examples.english: Children begin to develop a sense of self around age three.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自我|じが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}すぎて、⟦チームワーク→チームワーク：10995_chiimuwaaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかない。
examples.english: He has too strong an ego, so teamwork doesn't go well.

notes:
USAGE:
{自我|じが} refers to the psychological concept of self or ego. It is more abstract and intellectual than ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ (oneself), which is a basic pronoun. {自我|じが} is often used in developmental psychology to describe a child's growing awareness of being a separate individual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自我|じが}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}める→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧ (to become self-aware)
- {自我|じが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽生|めば}える→芽生える：04594_mebaeru⟧ (self-awareness emerges)
- {自我|じが}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (to have a strong ego)
- {自我|じが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧ (to suppress one's ego)
- {自我|じが}⟦{崩壊|ほうかい}→崩壊：09067_houkai⟧ (ego collapse, loss of identity)
